reason: A's checklist reaches more of what Ruth actually knows: whether the costs are firm quotes, which brings out the roof's possible 15% rise, plus pledges already in hand ($11,000), a target opening date and all-or-nothing terms. Those are the facts that reassure a wary past backer who has already given elsewhere. B covers some of the same ground but misses the pledges and the opening date, wrongly says the deadline is seven months away, and would cut the 180-tickets figure.
